canonical_title: Isolation of hazardous substances, components, and operations

versions.title_at_revision: Isolation of hazardous substances, components, and operations
versions.text:
Standard: The air system design prevents damage to safety-critical subsystems and components and injury to crewmembers and passengers by ensuring isolation of hazardous substances or exposures. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review design, crewmember procedures, and maintenance documentation to ensure the air system is designed, built, operated, and maintained with isolation of hazardous substances to prevent exposure to crewmembers and passengers and damage to safety-critical subsystems and components. This includes verifying any corresponding corrective measures (e.g., separation, shielding, isolation, monitors, fail-safe, alerting systems).
